features.description: PetRenderer TypeScript interface with RendererCapabilities, LipSyncable, Expressible type guards. Compiles and is importable from src/overlay/renderer/.
SpriteRenderer wraps current SpriteEngine logic implementing PetRenderer. Overlay renders identically to v0.1.0 — same spritesheet, same animation states, same canvas output.
SkinManifest TypeScript type matching visual-rendering-spec v1.0 schema. Validation function rejects missing required fields (name, renderer, version).
RendererFactory creates correct renderer from skin.json renderer field: 'sprite' → SpriteRenderer, 'spine' → SpineRenderer. Unknown type throws descriptive error.
Rename system/themes.rs to system/skins.rs. Update mod.rs, lib.rs, and IPC handler registration. All 222 v0.1.0 tests still pass.

Skin discovery: list_skins IPC returns merged catalog from bundled skins (public/skins/) and user-installed skins ($APPDATA/Ditto/skins/). Each entry includes name, renderer, preview path, source tag.
import_skin_zip IPC: validates skin.json presence + required fields, extracts to user data dir with path-traversal protection. New skin appears in list_skins output.
import_skin_url IPC: downloads zip from URL, validates, installs. delete_skin removes user-installed skin; bundled skins cannot be deleted. get/set_active_skin persist in settings DB.
SpineRenderer loads .skel/.json + .atlas + textures via @esotericsoftware/spine-canvas. Plays animations mapped via state_map. hitTest uses skeleton bounds. Implements PetRenderer interface.
Sample Spine skin in public/skins/sample-spine/ with valid skeleton.json, atlas, textures, and skin.json. Loads in SpineRenderer and plays idle animation without flicker.
features.notes: Requires a valid Spine-exported asset. May need to hand-craft a minimal valid skeleton if no Spine Editor license available.

features.description: Pet Manager unified window: tray menu opens Pet Manager instead of individual windows. Old standalone chat-bubble.ts, care-panel.ts, settings.ts launchers removed. All UI accessible via Vue routes.
/skins route in Pet Manager: grid layout with live preview animations per skin, renderer-type filter tabs (Sprite/Spine), bond-lock badges (all unlocked in v0.1.5).
Settings migration: active_skin setting added with default 'default'. Existing settings load correctly. No data loss from themes→skins rename.
AgentBackend trait scaffold in Rust: trait definition with send_message method. BuiltinAgent marked as implementor. No behavior change — existing code compiles and all 222+ tests pass.
features.notes: Forward-compat scaffold only. ExternalAgentChannel implementation is Phase 9.
